query_entity.title: Query any entity
query_entity.description: Run a filtered query against any Autotask entity by name -- Tickets, Companies, InventoryItems, whatever the catalogue holds. filter is an array of {op, field, value} conditions; use [{"op":"gte","field":"id","value":0}] to match everything.

entity.description: Entity name as Autotask spells it, e.g. Tickets or ConfigurationItems.

filter.description: Conditions of op, field and value; udf true for user-defined fields.

max_records.description: Records to return, up to 500 per page.

include_fields.description: Field names to return; omit for the whole record.

output.description: The matching records, with a pageDetails block for paging.

search_entity.title: Search any entity with a URL query
search_entity.description: The GET form of the entity query, taking the whole search document as one JSON string. Useful when you already have a search expression to hand; prefer query_entity for anything you are building up yourself.

entity.description: Entity name as Autotask spells it, e.g. Tickets.

output.description: The matching records, with a pageDetails block for paging.

count_entity.title: Count matching entity records
count_entity.description: Count the records a filter would return, without pulling them. The same filter syntax as query_entity, and the cheap way to size a result set.

entity.description: Entity name as Autotask spells it, e.g. Tickets.

filter.description: Conditions of op, field and value.

output.description: The number of matching records, as queryCount.

get_entity_record.title: Get any entity record by id
get_entity_record.description: Read a single record of any entity by its id, which is the cheapest read in the API when you already know the id.

entity.description: Entity name as Autotask spells it, e.g. Tickets.

output.description: The record, under an item key.

create_entity_record.title: Create any entity record
create_entity_record.description: Create a record of any entity from a field map. Call get_entity_fields first to see which fields are required and which picklist values are valid.

entity.description: Entity name as Autotask spells it, e.g. Tickets.

record.description: Field values for the new record.

output.description: The id of the created record.

update_entity_record.title: Update any entity record
update_entity_record.description: Patch a record of any entity. The record object must carry the id of the row to change along with the fields being set -- Autotask takes the id from the body, not the path.

entity.description: Entity name as Autotask spells it, e.g. Tickets.

record.description: Field values to change, including the record's id.

output.description: The id of the updated record.

replace_entity_record.title: Replace any entity record
replace_entity_record.description: Replace a record of any entity wholesale. Fields you leave out are reset to their defaults, so patch instead unless you really mean to.

entity.description: Entity name as Autotask spells it, e.g. Tickets.

record.description: The complete record, including its id.

output.description: The id of the replaced record.

get_entity_information.title: Get an entity's capabilities
get_entity_information.description: Read what the API allows on an entity -- whether it can be created, updated, deleted or queried, and whether it supports user-defined fields and webhooks.

entity.description: Entity name as Autotask spells it, e.g. Tickets.

output.description: The entity's capability flags.

get_entity_fields.title: Get an entity's field definitions
get_entity_fields.description: List an entity's fields with their data types, lengths, required flags, whether they are read-only, and the picklist values any picklist field accepts. This is how you learn what an integer status code means.

entity.description: Entity name as Autotask spells it, e.g. Tickets.

output.description: The field definitions, with picklist values where applicable.

get_entity_udf_fields.title: Get an entity's user-defined fields
get_entity_udf_fields.description: List the user-defined fields configured on an entity in this Autotask instance, with their types and picklist values.

entity.description: Entity name as Autotask spells it, e.g. Tickets.

output.description: The user-defined field definitions.

get_api_version.title: Get the API version
get_api_version.description: Read the REST API version this zone is running, which is the simplest call to confirm the credentials and zone are wired up correctly.

output.description: The API version string.

get_threshold_information.title: Get the API request threshold
get_threshold_information.description: Read how much of the hourly API request allowance this integration has used. Autotask throttles per integration code, so check here when calls start failing.

output.description: The threshold, current usage and time frame.

get_zone_information.title: Get a user's zone information
get_zone_information.description: Look up which Autotask zone hosts a given API user, returning the web url and REST base url for it. Use it to confirm the connection's subdomain is the right zone.

user.description: API user name (email address) to look the zone up for.

output.description: The zone's name, url, web url and CI number.

query_tickets.title: Query tickets
query_tickets.description: Search service tickets with a filter -- by company, status, queue, assigned resource, priority or create date. Status and priority are integer picklist ids; get_entity_fields on Tickets maps them to labels.

filter.description: Conditions of op, field and value, e.g. [{"op":"eq","field":"status","value":1}].

max_records.description: Tickets to return, up to 500 per page.

include_fields.description: Field names to return; omit for the whole ticket.

output.description: The matching tickets, with a pageDetails block for paging.

count_tickets.title: Count tickets
count_tickets.description: Count the tickets a filter matches without fetching them -- the way to size a queue or a backlog before pulling it.

filter.description: Conditions of op, field and value.

output.description: The number of matching tickets, as queryCount.

get_ticket.title: Get a ticket
get_ticket.description: Read one ticket by id, with its company, contact, status, queue, assignment, SLA timestamps and description.

output.description: The ticket record.

create_ticket.title: Create a ticket
create_ticket.description: Open a service ticket. companyID, title, status and priority are the fields Autotask insists on for most configurations; queueID or assignedResourceID decides who picks it up.

status.description: Status picklist id, e.g. 1 for New.

queue_id.description: Queue picklist id to route the ticket to.

assigned_resource_id.description: Resource id to assign the ticket to.

assigned_resource_role_id.description: Role the assigned resource works this ticket under.

ticket_type.description: Ticket type picklist id, e.g. service request or incident.

ticket_category.description: Ticket category id, which controls the form layout.

sub_issue_type.description: Sub-issue type picklist id, valid for the chosen issue type.

source.description: Source picklist id saying how the ticket arrived.

due_date_time.description: When the ticket is due, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

billing_code_id.description: Work type or billing code for the ticket.

external_id.description: Your own identifier for the ticket.

user_defined_fields.description: Entries of name and value for user-defined fields.

output.description: The id of the created ticket.

update_ticket.title: Update a ticket
update_ticket.description: Change a ticket -- status, assignment, priority, resolution and so on. The id goes in the body, and only the fields you send are touched.

queue_id.description: Queue to move the ticket to.

assigned_resource_id.description: Resource to assign the ticket to.

assigned_resource_role_id.description: Role the assigned resource works under.

resolution.description: Resolution text, needed by most statuses that close a ticket.

due_date_time.description: New due date as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

estimated_hours.description: New estimate of hours of work.

billing_code_id.description: New work type or billing code.

user_defined_fields.description: Entries of name and value for user-defined fields.

output.description: The id of the updated ticket.

query_ticket_notes.title: Query ticket notes
query_ticket_notes.description: Search notes across tickets, for instance every note on one ticket or everything a resource wrote this week. publish decides who can see a note.

filter.description: Conditions of op, field and value, e.g. on ticketID.

max_records.description: Notes to return, up to 500 per page.

output.description: The matching ticket notes.

create_ticket_note.title: Add a note to a ticket
create_ticket_note.description: Add a note to a ticket. noteType and publish are picklist ids -- publish is what controls whether the customer sees it in the client portal.

parent_id.description: Ticket id the note belongs to.

ticket_id.description: Ticket id, repeated in the body as Autotask expects.

publish.description: Publish picklist id deciding who can see the note.

output.description: The id of the created note.

list_ticket_charges.title: List a ticket's charges
list_ticket_charges.description: Read the product and cost charges posted against a ticket, with unit price, quantity and billing status.

parent_id.description: Ticket id whose charges to list.

output.description: The charges on the ticket.

create_ticket_charge.title: Add a charge to a ticket
create_ticket_charge.description: Post a product or cost charge onto a ticket, which is how materials and one-off fees reach the invoice.

parent_id.description: Ticket id to charge.

ticket_id.description: Ticket id, repeated in the body as Autotask expects.

description.description: Description of what is being charged.

product_id.description: Product being charged, when it comes from the catalogue.

unit_quantity.description: How many units are being charged.

unit_price.description: Price per unit charged to the customer.

billing_code_id.description: Billing code the charge posts under.

date_purchased.description: Purchase date as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

is_billable_to_company.description: True to bill the charge to the customer.

output.description: The id of the created charge.

list_ticket_checklist_items.title: List a ticket's checklist items
list_ticket_checklist_items.description: Read the checklist on a ticket, with each item's name, position and whether it is complete.

parent_id.description: Ticket id whose checklist to read.

output.description: The ticket's checklist items.

create_ticket_checklist_item.title: Add a checklist item to a ticket
create_ticket_checklist_item.description: Add one item to a ticket's checklist, optionally pointing at a knowledge base article for the step.

parent_id.description: Ticket id to add the item to.

ticket_id.description: Ticket id, repeated in the body as Autotask expects.

position.description: Where the item sits in the list.

is_important.description: True to flag the item as important.

is_completed.description: True to add the item already ticked off.

knowledgebase_article_id.description: Knowledge base article that explains the step.

output.description: The id of the created checklist item.

list_ticket_secondary_resources.title: List a ticket's secondary resources
list_ticket_secondary_resources.description: Read the resources helping on a ticket alongside its primary assignee, each with the role they work under.

parent_id.description: Ticket id whose secondary resources to list.

output.description: The secondary resources on the ticket.

add_ticket_secondary_resource.title: Add a secondary resource to a ticket
add_ticket_secondary_resource.description: Put another resource on a ticket without taking it away from its primary assignee, so both can log time against it.

parent_id.description: Ticket id to add the resource to.

ticket_id.description: Ticket id, repeated in the body as Autotask expects.

resource_id.description: Resource to add to the ticket.

role_id.description: Role the resource works this ticket under.

output.description: The id of the created association.

list_ticket_attachments.title: List a ticket's attachments
list_ticket_attachments.description: Read the attachment records on a ticket -- file names, types, sizes and who attached them. The file data itself is fetched per attachment.

parent_id.description: Ticket id whose attachments to list.

output.description: The attachment records on the ticket.

get_ticket_attachment.title: Get a ticket attachment
get_ticket_attachment.description: Read one attachment on a ticket, including its base64 data when Autotask stores the file inline rather than as a URL.

parent_id.description: Ticket id the attachment belongs to.

output.description: The attachment record with its data.

delete_ticket_attachment.title: Delete a ticket attachment
delete_ticket_attachment.description: Remove an attachment from a ticket. The file is deleted along with the record.

parent_id.description: Ticket id the attachment belongs to.

output.description: The id of the deleted attachment.

query_ticket_history.title: Query ticket history
query_ticket_history.description: Search the audit trail of field changes on tickets, which is how you see who changed a status or reassigned a ticket and when.

filter.description: Conditions of op, field and value, e.g. on ticketID.

max_records.description: History rows to return, up to 500 per page.

output.description: The matching history rows with their before and after values.

query_companies.title: Query companies
query_companies.description: Search companies (accounts) with a filter -- by name, type, owner, territory or active flag. companyType separates customers from prospects, vendors and partners.

filter.description: Conditions of op, field and value, e.g. on companyName or isActive.

max_records.description: Companies to return, up to 500 per page.

include_fields.description: Field names to return; omit for the whole record.

output.description: The matching companies, with a pageDetails block for paging.

get_company.title: Get a company
get_company.description: Read one company by id, with its addresses, billing settings, owner, territory and classification.

output.description: The company record.

create_company.title: Create a company
create_company.description: Create a company (account). companyName, companyType, ownerResourceID and phone are the fields Autotask normally requires; companyType 1 is Customer, 2 Lead, 3 Prospect, 4 Dead, 6 Vendor and 7 Partner.

company_type.description: Company type picklist id, e.g. 1 for Customer.

address1.description: First line of the street address.

address2.description: Second line of the street address.

country_id.description: Country id, from the Countries entity.

company_number.description: Your own account number for the company.

company_category_id.description: Company category, which controls the form layout.

currency_id.description: Currency the company is billed in.

is_tax_exempt.description: True if the company pays no tax.

is_active.description: False to create the company inactive.

user_defined_fields.description: Entries of name and value for user-defined fields.

output.description: The id of the created company.

update_company.title: Update a company
update_company.description: Change a company's details -- address, owner, classification, billing settings or active flag. The id goes in the body.

address1.description: New first line of the street address.

address2.description: New second line of the street address.

user_defined_fields.description: Entries of name and value for user-defined fields.

output.description: The id of the updated company.

list_company_contacts.title: List a company's contacts
list_company_contacts.description: Read the contacts attached to one company, each with their email, phone numbers and whether they are the primary contact.

parent_id.description: Company id whose contacts to list.

output.description: The company's contacts.

list_company_locations.title: List a company's locations
list_company_locations.description: Read the sites on one company, with their addresses, time zones and which is the primary location.

parent_id.description: Company id whose locations to list.

output.description: The company's locations.

list_company_notes.title: List a company's notes
list_company_notes.description: Read the account notes on one company, with their action type, author and activity dates.

parent_id.description: Company id whose notes to list.

output.description: The company's notes.

create_company_note.title: Add a note to a company
create_company_note.description: Write an account note against a company, optionally tied to a contact or opportunity and given an action type such as a call or a meeting.

parent_id.description: Company id the note belongs to.

company_id.description: Company id, repeated in the body as Autotask expects.

action_type.description: Action type picklist id, e.g. a call or a meeting.

assigned_resource_id.description: Resource the note is assigned to.

start_date_time.description: When the activity starts, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

end_date_time.description: When the activity ends, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

completed_date_time.description: When the activity was completed, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

output.description: The id of the created note.

list_company_todos.title: List a company's to-dos
list_company_todos.description: Read the CRM to-do activities on a company, with their assignee, action type and due dates.

parent_id.description: Company id whose to-dos to list.

output.description: The company's to-do activities.

create_company_todo.title: Add a to-do to a company
create_company_todo.description: Schedule a CRM to-do against a company -- a call to make, a meeting to hold -- assigned to a resource with a start and end time.

parent_id.description: Company id the to-do belongs to.

company_id.description: Company id, repeated in the body as Autotask expects.

action_type.description: Action type picklist id for the activity.

start_date_time.description: When the activity starts, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

end_date_time.description: When the activity ends, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

output.description: The id of the created to-do.

list_company_alerts.title: List a company's alerts
list_company_alerts.description: Read the alerts configured on a company -- the banners Autotask shows users who open a ticket or an opportunity for it.

parent_id.description: Company id whose alerts to list.

output.description: The company's alerts and where each is displayed.

list_company_site_configurations.title: List a company's site configuration
list_company_site_configurations.description: Read the site configuration values recorded against a company, the free-form technical detail MSPs keep about a customer's environment.

parent_id.description: Company id whose site configuration to read.

output.description: The company's site configuration values.

query_contacts.title: Query contacts
query_contacts.description: Search contacts with a filter -- by company, email address, name or active flag. isActive is an integer here rather than a boolean.

filter.description: Conditions of op, field and value, e.g. on emailAddress.

max_records.description: Contacts to return, up to 500 per page.

include_fields.description: Field names to return; omit for the whole record.

output.description: The matching contacts, with a pageDetails block for paging.

get_contact.title: Get a contact
get_contact.description: Read one contact by id, with their company, email addresses, phone numbers, address and opt-out flags.

output.description: The contact record.

create_contact.title: Create a contact
create_contact.description: Add a contact to a company. Autotask treats contacts as children of a company, so the company id appears in the path as well as the body.

parent_id.description: Company id the contact belongs to.

company_id.description: Company id, repeated in the body as Autotask expects.

country_id.description: Country id, from the Countries entity.

company_location_id.description: Company location the contact sits at.

primary_contact.description: True to make this the company's primary contact.

billing_contact.description: True to make this the company's billing contact.

receives_email_notifications.description: True to send ticket notifications to this contact.

external_id.description: Your own identifier for the contact.

user_defined_fields.description: Entries of name and value for user-defined fields.

output.description: The id of the created contact.

update_contact.title: Update a contact
update_contact.description: Change a contact's details. Like creation this goes through the owning company's path, and the contact's own id goes in the body.

parent_id.description: Company id the contact belongs to.

company_location_id.description: New company location for the contact.

primary_contact.description: True to make this the company's primary contact.

billing_contact.description: True to make this the company's billing contact.

receives_email_notifications.description: True to send ticket notifications to this contact.

user_defined_fields.description: Entries of name and value for user-defined fields.

output.description: The id of the updated contact.

query_time_entries.title: Query time entries
query_time_entries.description: Search logged time with a filter -- by resource, ticket, task, date worked or billing approval state. This is the entity payroll and invoicing reports are built on.

filter.description: Conditions of op, field and value, e.g. on dateWorked or resourceID.

max_records.description: Entries to return, up to 500 per page.

include_fields.description: Field names to return; omit for the whole record.

output.description: The matching time entries, with a pageDetails block for paging.

get_time_entry.title: Get a time entry
get_time_entry.description: Read one time entry by id, with its hours, dates, notes, role and billing state.

output.description: The time entry record.

create_time_entry.title: Log a time entry
create_time_entry.description: Log worked time against a ticket or a task. Pass exactly one of ticketID or taskID; dateWorked plus hoursWorked is the minimum, and billingCodeID with roleID is what makes it billable correctly.

ticket_id.description: Ticket the time was worked on.

task_id.description: Project task the time was worked on.

resource_id.description: Resource who did the work; defaults to the API user.

date_worked.description: Date the work happened, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

start_date_time.description: When work started, where the contract requires start and stop times.

end_date_time.description: When work stopped, where the contract requires start and stop times.

hours_to_bill.description: Hours to charge the customer, when different from hours worked.

offset_hours.description: Unbilled hours deducted from the entry.

billing_code_id.description: Work type the time bills under.

role_id.description: Role the resource worked under, which sets the rate.

is_non_billable.description: True to log the time as non-billable.

show_on_invoice.description: True to print the entry's notes on the invoice.

output.description: The id of the created time entry.

update_time_entry.title: Update a time entry
update_time_entry.description: Change logged time -- hours, notes, billing code or role. The id goes in the body, and entries already approved and posted are locked.

date_worked.description: New date worked, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

billing_code_id.description: New work type for the entry.

is_non_billable.description: True to make the time non-billable.

show_on_invoice.description: True to print the notes on the invoice.

output.description: The id of the updated time entry.

delete_time_entry.title: Delete a time entry
delete_time_entry.description: Delete a logged time entry. Entries that have already been approved and posted cannot be removed this way.

output.description: The id of the deleted time entry.

query_projects.title: Query projects
query_projects.description: Search projects with a filter -- by company, status, project lead or dates -- with their budgets, estimates and completion percentage.

filter.description: Conditions of op, field and value, e.g. on companyID or status.

max_records.description: Projects to return, up to 500 per page.

include_fields.description: Field names to return; omit for the whole record.

output.description: The matching projects, with a pageDetails block for paging.

get_project.title: Get a project
get_project.description: Read one project by id, with its dates, status, budget figures and actual hours to date.

output.description: The project record.

create_project.title: Create a project
create_project.description: Create a project for a company. projectName, companyID, type, status and the start and end dates are the fields Autotask requires; contractID ties the work to a contract for billing.

start_date_time.description: Planned start, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

end_date_time.description: Planned end, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

department.description: Department picklist id owning the project.

estimated_time.description: Estimated hours for the whole project.

user_defined_fields.description: Entries of name and value for user-defined fields.

output.description: The id of the created project.

update_project.title: Update a project
update_project.description: Change a project's status, dates, lead or budget figures. The id goes in the body.

completed_date_time.description: When the project completed, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

user_defined_fields.description: Entries of name and value for user-defined fields.

output.description: The id of the updated project.

list_project_phases.title: List a project's phases
list_project_phases.description: Read the phases of one project, which is the structure its tasks hang off.

parent_id.description: Project id whose phases to list.

output.description: The project's phases.

create_project_phase.title: Add a phase to a project
create_project_phase.description: Create a phase inside a project, optionally nested under another phase, to group the tasks that belong together.

parent_id.description: Project id the phase belongs to.

project_id.description: Project id, repeated in the body as Autotask expects.

start_date.description: Phase start, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

due_date.description: Phase due date, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

external_id.description: Your own identifier for the phase.

is_scheduled.description: True if the phase is scheduled rather than a container.

output.description: The id of the created phase.

query_tasks.title: Query project tasks
query_tasks.description: Search project tasks with a filter -- by project, phase, assigned resource, status or dates -- with their estimated and remaining hours.

filter.description: Conditions of op, field and value, e.g. on projectID.

max_records.description: Tasks to return, up to 500 per page.

include_fields.description: Field names to return; omit for the whole record.

output.description: The matching tasks, with a pageDetails block for paging.

get_task.title: Get a project task
get_task.description: Read one project task by id, with its phase, assignment, status, dates and hours.

output.description: The task record.

create_task.title: Create a project task
create_task.description: Add a task to a project. Autotask treats tasks as children of a project, so the project id appears in the path as well as the body.

parent_id.description: Project id the task belongs to.

project_id.description: Project id, repeated in the body as Autotask expects.

assigned_resource_id.description: Resource the task is assigned to.

assigned_resource_role_id.description: Role the assigned resource works under.

start_date_time.description: Planned start, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

end_date_time.description: Planned end, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

task_category_id.description: Task category, which controls the form layout.

billing_code_id.description: Work type the task bills under.

is_visible_in_client_portal.description: True to show the task to the customer.

is_task_billable.description: True if work on the task is billable.

external_id.description: Your own identifier for the task.

user_defined_fields.description: Entries of name and value for user-defined fields.

output.description: The id of the created task.

update_task.title: Update a project task
update_task.description: Change a task's status, assignment, dates or hours. Like creation this goes through the project path, with the task's id in the body.

parent_id.description: Project id the task belongs to.

phase_id.description: Phase to move the task to.

assigned_resource_id.description: Resource to assign the task to.

assigned_resource_role_id.description: Role the assigned resource works under.

completed_date_time.description: When the task completed, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

user_defined_fields.description: Entries of name and value for user-defined fields.

output.description: The id of the updated task.

list_project_notes.title: List a project's notes
list_project_notes.description: Read the notes on one project, with their author, type and publish setting.

parent_id.description: Project id whose notes to list.

output.description: The project's notes.

create_project_note.title: Add a note to a project
create_project_note.description: Write a note against a project. publish controls whether the customer sees it in the client portal.

parent_id.description: Project id the note belongs to.

project_id.description: Project id, repeated in the body as Autotask expects.

publish.description: Publish picklist id deciding who can see the note.

output.description: The id of the created note.

query_contracts.title: Query contracts
query_contracts.description: Search contracts with a filter -- by company, type, status or dates. The contract type decides how work bills: block hours, retainer, recurring service, fixed price or time and materials.

filter.description: Conditions of op, field and value, e.g. on companyID or status.

max_records.description: Contracts to return, up to 500 per page.

include_fields.description: Field names to return; omit for the whole record.

output.description: The matching contracts, with a pageDetails block for paging.

get_contract.title: Get a contract
get_contract.description: Read one contract by id, with its type, period, dates, billing preference and estimated values.

output.description: The contract record.

create_contract.title: Create a contract
create_contract.description: Create a contract for a company. contractName, companyID, contractType, startDate and endDate are required; contractPeriodType matters for recurring service contracts.

contract_type.description: Contract type picklist id, e.g. block hours or recurring service.

start_date.description: Contract start, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

end_date.description: Contract end, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

contract_period_type.description: Billing period for a recurring service contract.

billing_preference.description: How work on the contract is billed.

contact_id.description: Contact who owns the contract at the customer.

bill_to_company_id.description: Company to invoice, when it differs from the contract company.

bill_to_company_contact_id.description: Billing contact at the company being invoiced.

estimated_hours.description: Estimated hours over the contract's life.

estimated_cost.description: Estimated cost of delivering the contract.

overage_billing_rate.description: Hourly rate charged once the contract is exhausted.

service_level_agreement_id.description: SLA that applies to work under the contract.

is_default_contract.description: True to make this the company's default contract.

user_defined_fields.description: Entries of name and value for user-defined fields.

output.description: The id of the created contract.

update_contract.title: Update a contract
update_contract.description: Change a contract's dates, status, estimates or billing settings. The id goes in the body.

user_defined_fields.description: Entries of name and value for user-defined fields.

output.description: The id of the updated contract.

list_contract_services.title: List a contract's services
list_contract_services.description: Read the recurring services attached to a contract, with the adjusted unit price and cost each carries.

parent_id.description: Contract id whose services to list.

output.description: The services on the contract.

add_contract_service.title: Add a service to a contract
add_contract_service.description: Attach a catalogue service to a recurring service contract, overriding its unit price or cost for this customer if you need to.

parent_id.description: Contract id to add the service to.

contract_id.description: Contract id, repeated in the body as Autotask expects.

unit_price.description: Price per unit for this contract.

unit_cost.description: Cost per unit for this contract.

invoice_description.description: Text shown for the service on invoices.

internal_description.description: Internal-only description of the service line.

quote_item_id.description: Quote item the service came from.

output.description: The id of the created contract service.

list_contract_blocks.title: List a contract's hour blocks
list_contract_blocks.description: Read the purchased hour blocks on a block-hours contract, with hours bought, hours approved, rate and payment status.

parent_id.description: Contract id whose blocks to list.

output.description: The hour blocks on the contract.

add_contract_block.title: Add an hour block to a contract
add_contract_block.description: Sell a block of hours against a block-hours contract, with the rate and the period the hours are valid for.

parent_id.description: Contract id to add the block to.

contract_id.description: Contract id, repeated in the body as Autotask expects.

hourly_rate.description: Rate charged per hour in the block.

start_date.description: When the block becomes usable, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

end_date.description: When the block expires, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

date_purchased.description: Purchase date, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

payment_number.description: Cheque or transaction number for the payment.

invoice_number.description: Invoice number the block was billed on.

is_paid.description: True if the block has been paid for.

output.description: The id of the created block.

list_contract_rates.title: List a contract's role rates
list_contract_rates.description: Read the per-role hourly rates set on a contract, which is what overrides the standard role rate for this customer.

parent_id.description: Contract id whose rates to list.

output.description: The contract's per-role rates.

add_contract_rate.title: Set a role rate on a contract
add_contract_rate.description: Set the hourly rate a role bills at under one contract, overriding the role's default rate.

parent_id.description: Contract id to set the rate on.

contract_id.description: Contract id, repeated in the body as Autotask expects.

contract_hourly_rate.description: Hourly rate for that role on this contract.

output.description: The id of the created contract rate.

list_contract_notes.title: List a contract's notes
list_contract_notes.description: Read the notes recorded against a contract, with their titles, authors and activity dates.

parent_id.description: Contract id whose notes to list.

output.description: The contract's notes.

create_contract_note.title: Add a note to a contract
create_contract_note.description: Write a note against a contract, for recording renewal conversations and scope decisions where they will be found again.

parent_id.description: Contract id the note belongs to.

contract_id.description: Contract id, repeated in the body as Autotask expects.

output.description: The id of the created note.

query_configuration_items.title: Query configuration items
query_configuration_items.description: Search configuration items (installed products) with a filter -- by company, product, type, serial number or RMM device fields. This is the asset inventory.

filter.description: Conditions of op, field and value, e.g. on companyID or serialNumber.

max_records.description: Items to return, up to 500 per page.

include_fields.description: Field names to return; omit for the whole record, which is large.

output.description: The matching configuration items, with a pageDetails block.

get_configuration_item.title: Get a configuration item
get_configuration_item.description: Read one configuration item by id, with its product, company, contract, warranty dates and any RMM or Datto audit fields.

output.description: The configuration item record.

create_configuration_item.title: Create a configuration item
create_configuration_item.description: Register an asset against a company. companyID, configurationItemType and productID are the usual requirements; serialNumber and referenceTitle are what make it findable later.

product_id.description: Catalogue product the asset is an instance of.

reference_number.description: Your own reference number for the asset.

company_location_id.description: Company location the asset sits at.

configuration_item_category_id.description: Category, which controls the form layout.

parent_configuration_item_id.description: Parent asset, for a component of another item.

install_date.description: Install date, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

warranty_expiration_date.description: Warranty expiry, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

number_of_users.description: How many users the asset serves.

setup_fee.description: One-off setup fee for the asset.

vendor_id.description: Vendor the asset was bought from.

is_active.description: False to register the asset inactive.

user_defined_fields.description: Entries of name and value for user-defined fields.

output.description: The id of the created configuration item.

update_configuration_item.title: Update a configuration item
update_configuration_item.description: Change an asset -- its contract, location, warranty dates, costs or active flag. The id goes in the body.

contact_id.description: New contact who uses the asset.

company_location_id.description: New company location for the asset.

user_defined_fields.description: Entries of name and value for user-defined fields.

output.description: The id of the updated configuration item.

list_configuration_item_notes.title: List an asset's notes
list_configuration_item_notes.description: Read the notes recorded against one configuration item, with their type and author.

parent_id.description: Configuration item id whose notes to list.

output.description: The asset's notes.

create_configuration_item_note.title: Add a note to an asset
create_configuration_item_note.description: Write a note against a configuration item, for recording maintenance and configuration history on the device itself.

parent_id.description: Configuration item id the note belongs to.

configuration_item_id.description: Configuration item id, repeated in the body as Autotask expects.

output.description: The id of the created note.

query_subscriptions.title: Query asset subscriptions
query_subscriptions.description: Search the recurring subscriptions billed against configuration items, with their period cost, price and effective dates.

filter.description: Conditions of op, field and value, e.g. on configurationItemID.

max_records.description: Subscriptions to return, up to 500 per page.

output.description: The matching subscriptions.

create_subscription.title: Create an asset subscription
create_subscription.description: Bill a recurring charge against a configuration item over a period -- the usual way per-device monthly fees reach the invoice.

configuration_item_id.description: Configuration item the subscription bills against.

material_code_id.description: Material or billing code the charge posts under.

period_type.description: Billing period picklist id, e.g. monthly or annual.

effective_date.description: When billing starts, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

expiration_date.description: When billing stops, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

output.description: The id of the created subscription.

delete_subscription.title: Delete an asset subscription
delete_subscription.description: Delete a subscription, which stops its recurring charges. Periods already billed stay on their invoices.

output.description: The id of the deleted subscription.

query_opportunities.title: Query opportunities
query_opportunities.description: Search sales opportunities with a filter -- by company, owner, stage, status or projected close date -- with their amounts and probability.

filter.description: Conditions of op, field and value, e.g. on ownerResourceID.

max_records.description: Opportunities to return, up to 500 per page.

include_fields.description: Field names to return; omit for the whole record.

output.description: The matching opportunities, with a pageDetails block.

get_opportunity.title: Get an opportunity
get_opportunity.description: Read one opportunity by id, with its amount, stage, probability, dates and revenue breakdown.

output.description: The opportunity record.

create_opportunity.title: Create an opportunity
create_opportunity.description: Open a sales opportunity. title, companyID, ownerResourceID, amount, stage, status, probability and projectedCloseDate are the fields Autotask requires for a forecastable opportunity.

projected_close_date.description: Expected close date, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

start_date.description: When the opportunity started, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

next_step.description: The next action to move the deal forward.

barriers.description: What stands in the way of winning.

help_needed.description: What help the owner needs to close it.

use_quote_totals.description: True to take the amount from the primary quote instead.

user_defined_fields.description: Entries of name and value for user-defined fields.

output.description: The id of the created opportunity.

update_opportunity.title: Update an opportunity
update_opportunity.description: Move an opportunity along -- change its stage, amount, probability or close date, or record why it was won or lost. The id goes in the body.

closed_date.description: When the opportunity was won, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

lost_date.description: When the opportunity was lost, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

win_reason_detail.description: Narrative on why it was won.

loss_reason_detail.description: Narrative on why it was lost.

user_defined_fields.description: Entries of name and value for user-defined fields.

output.description: The id of the updated opportunity.

query_quotes.title: Query quotes
query_quotes.description: Search quotes with a filter -- by company, opportunity, approval status or effective date -- with their templates and payment terms.

filter.description: Conditions of op, field and value, e.g. on opportunityID.

max_records.description: Quotes to return, up to 500 per page.

output.description: The matching quotes.

get_quote.title: Get a quote
get_quote.description: Read one quote by id, with its dates, approval state, locations and payment terms.

output.description: The quote record.

create_quote.title: Create a quote
create_quote.description: Create a quote against an opportunity. The bill-to, ship-to and sold-to location ids all point at company locations, and effectiveDate plus expirationDate bound its validity.

contact_id.description: Contact the quote is addressed to.

effective_date.description: When the quote takes effect, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

expiration_date.description: When the quote expires, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

quote_template_id.description: Template used when the quote is published.

primary_quote.description: True to make this the opportunity's primary quote.

calculate_tax_separately.description: True to show tax as its own line rather than in the totals.

is_active.description: False to create the quote inactive.

output.description: The id of the created quote.

query_quote_items.title: Query quote items
query_quote_items.description: Search the line items on quotes -- products, services, labour and shipping -- with quantities, unit prices, discounts and tax.

filter.description: Conditions of op, field and value, e.g. on quoteID.

max_records.description: Items to return, up to 500 per page.

output.description: The matching quote items.

query_service_calls.title: Query service calls
query_service_calls.description: Search scheduled service calls with a filter -- by company, date range, status or completion -- which is how dispatch boards are built.

filter.description: Conditions of op, field and value, e.g. on startDateTime.

max_records.description: Calls to return, up to 500 per page.

output.description: The matching service calls.

get_service_call.title: Get a service call
get_service_call.description: Read one service call by id, with its company, window, duration and completion state.

output.description: The service call record.

create_service_call.title: Create a service call
create_service_call.description: Schedule a service call for a company between two times. Attach tickets and resources to it afterwards through its child collections.

start_date_time.description: When the call starts, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

end_date_time.description: When the call ends, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

is_complete.description: 1 to mark the call complete on creation.

cancelation_notice_hours.description: Notice required to cancel without charge.

output.description: The id of the created service call.

update_service_call.title: Update a service call
update_service_call.description: Reschedule or close a service call -- change its window, status, duration or completion flag. The id goes in the body.

output.description: The id of the updated service call.

delete_service_call.title: Delete a service call
delete_service_call.description: Delete a scheduled service call, which removes it from the dispatch calendar along with its ticket and resource associations.

output.description: The id of the deleted service call.

query_appointments.title: Query appointments
query_appointments.description: Search resource calendar appointments by date range or resource, the non-ticket entries that still occupy someone's schedule.

filter.description: Conditions of op, field and value, e.g. on resourceID.

max_records.description: Appointments to return, up to 500 per page.

output.description: The matching appointments.

create_appointment.title: Create an appointment
create_appointment.description: Book time on a resource's calendar between two times -- training, leave, an internal meeting -- so the dispatcher sees them as busy.

start_date_time.description: Start time, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

end_date_time.description: End time, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

output.description: The id of the created appointment.

delete_appointment.title: Delete an appointment
delete_appointment.description: Remove an appointment from a resource's calendar, freeing the time for dispatch.

output.description: The id of the deleted appointment.

query_resources.title: Query resources
query_resources.description: Search Autotask users (resources) with a filter -- by name, email, active flag or licence type -- which is how you resolve the resource ids every other entity refers to.

filter.description: Conditions of op, field and value, e.g. on isActive or email.

max_records.description: Resources to return, up to 500 per page.

include_fields.description: Field names to return; omit for the whole record.

output.description: The matching resources.

get_resource.title: Get a resource
get_resource.description: Read one resource by id, with their name, email, licence type, default role and active flag.

output.description: The resource record.

query_roles.title: Query roles
query_roles.description: Search the roles resources work under, with their hourly rates and cost rates. Roles are what set the billing rate on a time entry.

filter.description: Conditions of op, field and value, e.g. on isActive.

max_records.description: Roles to return, up to 500 per page.

output.description: The matching roles with their rates.

query_resource_roles.title: Query resource role assignments
query_resource_roles.description: Search which resources hold which roles, in which departments and queues. This is the mapping dispatch and billing both depend on.

filter.description: Conditions of op, field and value, e.g. on resourceID.

max_records.description: Assignments to return, up to 500 per page.

output.description: The matching resource role assignments.

query_departments.title: Query departments
query_departments.description: List the departments configured in the instance, which projects, tasks and resources are organised by.

filter.description: Conditions of op, field and value.

max_records.description: Departments to return, up to 500 per page.

output.description: The matching departments.

query_products.title: Query products
query_products.description: Search the product catalogue with a filter -- by name, SKU, manufacturer, category or active flag -- with unit cost, price and MSRP.

filter.description: Conditions of op, field and value, e.g. on sku or isActive.

max_records.description: Products to return, up to 500 per page.

output.description: The matching products with their prices.

create_product.title: Create a product
create_product.description: Add a product to the catalogue. name, productBillingCodeID and billingType are required; unitCost and unitPrice drive the margin Autotask reports on.

product_billing_code_id.description: Material code the product bills under.

billing_type.description: Billing type picklist id, e.g. one-off or recurring.

period_type.description: Billing period for a recurring product.

manufacturer_product_name.description: Manufacturer's own name for the product.

default_vendor_id.description: Vendor the product is normally bought from.

external_product_id.description: Product id in an external system.

link.description: URL with more information about the product.

is_serialized.description: True if each unit carries a serial number.

is_active.description: False to add the product inactive.

user_defined_fields.description: Entries of name and value for user-defined fields.

output.description: The id of the created product.

query_services.title: Query services
query_services.description: Search the recurring service catalogue, with each service's unit price, cost, billing period and SLA.

filter.description: Conditions of op, field and value, e.g. on isActive.

max_records.description: Services to return, up to 500 per page.

output.description: The matching services with their prices.

create_service.title: Create a service
create_service.description: Add a recurring service to the catalogue, ready to be attached to recurring service contracts.

billing_code_id.description: Material code the service bills under.

period_type.description: Billing period picklist id, e.g. monthly or annual.

unit_cost.description: Your cost per unit per period.

unit_price.description: Price charged per unit per period.

invoice_description.description: Text shown for the service on invoices.

service_level_agreement_id.description: SLA that comes with the service.

url.description: URL with more information about the service.

is_active.description: False to add the service inactive.

user_defined_fields.description: Entries of name and value for user-defined fields.

output.description: The id of the created service.

query_billing_items.title: Query billing items
query_billing_items.description: Search the billing items Autotask has generated -- the approved time, charges and recurring fees waiting to be invoiced or already invoiced.

filter.description: Conditions of op, field and value, e.g. on companyID or invoiceID.

max_records.description: Items to return, up to 500 per page.

include_fields.description: Field names to return; omit for the whole record.

output.description: The matching billing items.

query_invoices.title: Query invoices
query_invoices.description: Search invoices with a filter -- by company, date, batch or paid status -- with their totals, tax and due dates.

filter.description: Conditions of op, field and value, e.g. on companyID.

max_records.description: Invoices to return, up to 500 per page.

output.description: The matching invoices with their totals.

get_invoice.title: Get an invoice
get_invoice.description: Read one invoice by id, with its totals, tax, batch and payment terms.

output.description: The invoice record.

query_expense_reports.title: Query expense reports
query_expense_reports.description: Search expense reports with a filter -- by submitter, approver, status or week ending -- with their totals and amounts due.

filter.description: Conditions of op, field and value, e.g. on submitterID.

max_records.description: Reports to return, up to 500 per page.

output.description: The matching expense reports.

create_expense_report.title: Create an expense report
create_expense_report.description: Open an expense report for a submitter and week, ready for expense items to be added to it.

week_ending.description: Week ending date, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

reimbursement_currency_id.description: Currency the submitter is reimbursed in.

submit.description: True to submit the report for approval immediately.

output.description: The id of the created expense report.

query_expense_items.title: Query expense items
query_expense_items.description: Search the individual lines on expense reports, with their expense category, amount, project or ticket and billable flag.

filter.description: Conditions of op, field and value, e.g. on expenseReportID.

max_records.description: Items to return, up to 500 per page.

output.description: The matching expense items.

query_ticket_webhooks.title: Query ticket webhooks
query_ticket_webhooks.description: List the webhooks registered for ticket events, with their URL, which events they subscribe to and whether they are active and ready.

filter.description: Conditions of op, field and value, e.g. on isActive.

max_records.description: Webhooks to return, up to 500 per page.

output.description: The matching ticket webhooks.

create_ticket_webhook.title: Create a ticket webhook
create_ticket_webhook.description: Register a webhook for ticket events. Autotask signs each delivery with the secretKey, and you choose which of create, update and delete to receive; add field subscriptions afterwards to decide the payload.

webhook_url.description: HTTPS URL Autotask posts events to.

secret_key.description: Shared secret Autotask signs deliveries with.

send_threshold_exceeded_notification.description: True to be emailed when the delivery threshold is exceeded.

deactivation_url.description: URL Autotask calls if it deactivates the webhook.

is_active.description: False to register the webhook inactive.

output.description: The id of the created webhook.

delete_ticket_webhook.title: Delete a ticket webhook
delete_ticket_webhook.description: Remove a ticket webhook, which stops Autotask delivering ticket events to that URL.

output.description: The id of the deleted webhook.

query_attachment_info.title: Query attachment metadata
query_attachment_info.description: Search attachment records across the instance -- their parent entity, file name, type, size and who attached them -- without pulling any file data.

filter.description: Conditions of op, field and value, e.g. on parentID or parentType.

max_records.description: Records to return, up to 500 per page.

output.description: The matching attachment metadata records.

query_notification_history.title: Query notification history
query_notification_history.description: Search the record of notification emails Autotask has sent -- who was notified about which entity, when, and from which template.

filter.description: Conditions of op, field and value, e.g. on entityNumber.

max_records.description: Records to return, up to 500 per page.

output.description: The matching notification history rows.
